options.map_wide: One setting for the whole map

start_all_area_mowing.name: Start all-area mowing
start_all_area_mowing.description: Start mowing the whole active map. A mowing session that is already running is continued.

from_stop_point.name: From the stop point
from_stop_point.description: Where an unfinished task stopped in a zone: on, mow only the rest of it; off, mow it from the beginning. Left out, the mower is not told.

end_task.name: End task
end_task.description: End the running mowing task. The mower stays where it is, and keeps where the task stopped so a later task can continue from there.

stop_returning.name: Stop returning
stop_returning.description: Stop the mower on its way back to the station. It stays where it is.

recharge.name: Recharge
recharge.description: Send the mower to its station to charge. A running mowing task is kept, so it can be continued afterwards.

start_zone_mowing.name: Start zone mowing
start_zone_mowing.description: Start mowing for one or more explicit zone IDs.

zone_ids.name: Zone IDs
zone_ids.description: List of zone IDs to mow, for example [1, 3].

from_stop_point.name: From the stop point
from_stop_point.description: Where an unfinished task stopped in a zone: on, mow only the rest of it; off, mow it from the beginning. Left out, the mower is not told.

start_edge_mowing.name: Start edge mowing
start_edge_mowing.description: Start mowing the edges for one or more explicit contour IDs.

contour_ids.name: Contour IDs
contour_ids.description: List of contour ID pairs to mow, for example [[1, 0], [2, 0]]. Available contour IDs are exposed in the mower entity's contours attribute once the map has been fetched.

start_spot_mowing.name: Start spot mowing
start_spot_mowing.description: Start mowing for one or more explicit spot area IDs.

spot_area_ids.name: Spot area IDs
spot_area_ids.description: List of spot area IDs to mow, for example [2, 4].

select_map.name: Select map
select_map.description: Make another map the one the mower works on. Not possible while a mowing task is in progress.

map_id.name: Map ID
map_id.description: Map to switch to. Available map IDs are exposed in the mower entity's maps attribute once the map has been fetched.

set_mowing_settings.name: Set mowing settings
set_mowing_settings.description: Change any of the mowing settings of a whole map, or of a single zone of it, in one go. Every setting left out keeps the value it has. A map that follows its per-zone settings gets the change written into every zone as well, since the mower no longer reads its map-wide settings. Settings a mower does not offer are refused.

efficiency.name: Mowing efficiency
efficiency.description: How fast the mower works. Efficient mows more per day, with less care around obstacles.

cutting_height.name: Cutting height
cutting_height.description: Cutting height in centimetres, in steps of 0.5 cm.

mowing_direction.name: Mowing direction
mowing_direction.description: The direction of the lanes in degrees, as the app shows it. Anything from 180 on names the same lanes as the angle half a turn below it.

mowing_direction_mode.name: Mowing direction mode
mowing_direction_mode.description: Whether every session mows in the same direction, or turns against the session before it.

automatic_edge_mowing.name: Automatic edge mowing
automatic_edge_mowing.description: Whether the mower mows the edges on its own once all-area or zone mowing has finished.

safe_edge_mowing.name: Safe edge mowing
safe_edge_mowing.description: Whether the mower keeps a small buffer from the lawn boundary while it mows the edges.

edge_blade_offset.name: Edge blade offset
edge_blade_offset.description: Whether the blade disc shifts to the side for the edge laps so the mower cuts closer to the boundary. Switching this on also raises a single edge lap to two.

edge_obstacle_avoidance.name: Obstacle avoidance on edges
edge_obstacle_avoidance.description: Whether the mower steers around obstacles along the edges too, which may leave some grass uncut there. It goes off by itself once neither the LiDAR nor the camera recognises obstacles.

lidar_obstacle_recognition.name: LiDAR obstacle recognition
lidar_obstacle_recognition.description: Whether the mower recognises obstacles with its LiDAR and avoids them without touching them. Switch it off to let the mower clear overgrown grass.

obstacle_height.name: Obstacle avoidance height
obstacle_height.description: The lowest obstacle the mower avoids, in centimetres.

obstacle_distance.name: Obstacle avoidance distance
obstacle_distance.description: How far the mower keeps away from obstacles, in centimetres. A shorter distance may lead to collisions or scrapes.

ai_obstacle_recognition.name: AI obstacle recognition
ai_obstacle_recognition.description: The obstacle kinds the camera recognises and the mower avoids. An empty list leaves avoiding obstacles to the bumper and the LiDAR. Only mowers with a camera offer it.

turning_method.name: Turning method
turning_method.description: How the mower turns at the end of a lane. Lawn care turns wider and spares the lawn, but needs some room to turn. Only newer firmware offers it.

map_id.name: Map ID
map_id.description: Map to change. Defaults to the active map.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to change instead of the whole map. Setting a zone also switches the map to per-zone mowing settings, so the other zones keep their own settings and the map-wide ones stop applying.

set_mowing_preference_mode.name: Set mowing preference mode
set_mowing_preference_mode.description: Choose whether a map applies one set of mowing settings or per-zone settings. Use this to return to a single map-wide cutting height after setting one for an individual zone. The mode covers the other mowing settings too, not only the cutting height.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Whether the map follows its map-wide or its per-zone settings.

map_id.name: Map ID
map_id.description: Map to change. Defaults to the active map.

set_no_go_zone.name: Set no-go zone
set_no_go_zone.description: Draw a no-go zone on the current map, or change one, in map coordinates (millimetres, as the map's zones are given). Returns the zone's id. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

shape.name: Shape
shape.description: A line the mower does not cross, a rectangle or a circle.

points.name: Points
points.description: A line's two ends, a rectangle's two opposite corners, or a circle's centre, each as [x, y].

zone_id.name: No-go zone ID
zone_id.description: The no-go zone to change instead of drawing a new one.

set_ignore_obstacle_area.name: Set ignore-obstacles area
set_ignore_obstacle_area.description: Draw an area on the current map where the mower only relies on its bumper and drives over low obstacles, or change one. Returns the area's id. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

rect.name: Rectangle
rect.description: Two opposite corners as [x0, y0, x1, y1], in millimetres.

area_id.name: Area ID
area_id.description: The area to change instead of drawing a new one.

set_spot_area.name: Set spot area
set_spot_area.description: Draw a spot area on the current map, or change one. It must lie within one zone. Returns the spot area's id. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

rect.name: Rectangle
rect.description: Two opposite corners as [x0, y0, x1, y1], in millimetres.

area_id.name: Spot area ID
area_id.description: The spot area to change instead of drawing a new one.

set_maintenance_point.name: Set maintenance point
set_maintenance_point.description: Place a maintenance point on the current map, or move one. Returns the point's id. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

x.name: X
x.description: Where the point lies, in millimetres.

y.name: Y
y.description: Where the point lies, in millimetres.

heading.name: Heading
heading.description: Which way the mower faces there, in degrees. Left out, a moved point keeps its heading and a new one faces 0 degrees.

point_id.name: Point ID
point_id.description: The point to move instead of placing a new one.

delete_map_item.name: Delete map item
delete_map_item.description: Delete a zone, path, no-go zone, spot area, maintenance point or ignore-obstacles area of the current map. Deleting a zone also drops its schedules. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: What kind of item it is.

rename_zone.name: Rename zone
rename_zone.description: Give a zone of the current map a new name of up to 24 characters. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

split_zone.name: Split zone
split_zone.description: Split a zone of the current map in two along a line across it. The schedules that name the zone are dropped. Returns the ids of the two zones. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

line.name: Line
line.description: The line's two ends as [x0, y0, x1, y1], in millimetres; it should reach across the zone.

merge_zones.name: Merge zones
merge_zones.description: Merge two neighbouring zones of the current map into one. Returns the merged zone's id. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

rename_map.name: Rename map
rename_map.description: Give a map a new name of up to 24 characters. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

clear_rain_protection.name: Clear rain protection
clear_rain_protection.description: Clear the rain the mower reports, so a mowing task started next runs even though its sensor saw water. Start the task right after; the mower takes no other action from it.

find_robot.name: Find robot
find_robot.description: Have the mower call out, so it can be found by its sound. It does not move.

clear_error.name: Clear error
clear_error.description: Clear the errors and warnings the mower reports, then let it go on: a paused task resumes, and a mower standing outside its station without a task drives home. The mower may move.

continue_task.name: Continue
continue_task.description: Resume the task, or drive home, once the errors are cleared. Off only clears them.

set_do_not_disturb.name: Set Do Not Disturb
set_do_not_disturb.description: Switch Do Not Disturb on or off, or change its window. No task starts in the window; a task that runs when it begins pauses and the mower returns to its station.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Switch it on or off; left out, it stays as it is.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the window starts; left out, it stays as it is.

end.name: End
end.description: When the window ends, on the next day when it is earlier than the start; left out, it stays as it is. Times lie between 00:01 and 23:59.

set_low_speed_at_night.name: Set low speed at night
set_low_speed_at_night.description: Switch the low speed at night on or off, or change its window, in which the mower drives slowly.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Switch it on or off; left out, it stays as it is.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the window starts; left out, it stays as it is.

end.name: End
end.description: When the window ends, on the next day when it is earlier than the start; left out, it stays as it is. Times lie between 00:01 and 23:59.

set_start_from_stop_point.name: Set start from stop point
set_start_from_stop_point.description: Choose whether a new task can go on from where an unfinished one stopped, and for how many days a stop point is kept. Switching it off clears the stop points the mower holds.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Switch it on or off; left out, it stays as it is.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days a stop point is kept, 1 to 7; left out, it stays as it is.

set_light.name: Set light
set_light.description: Change when the mower's lights are on: only within a custom period or all day, and in which states. Whatever is left out stays as it is.

custom_period.name: Custom period
custom_period.description: Keep the lights to the period from start to end.

standby.name: In standby
standby.description: Light while the mower stands by.

error.name: On errors
error.description: Light while the mower reports an error.

set_human_presence_alert.name: Set human presence alert
set_human_presence_alert.description: Change the alert the mower gives when its camera sees a person: whether it is on, how sensitive it is, when it watches, how it reports and how often. Whatever is left out stays as it is.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Switch the alert on or off.

sensitivity.name: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How readily a person is recognised.

standby.name: In standby
standby.description: Watch while the mower stands by.

returning.name: While returning
returning.description: Watch while the mower returns to its station.

voice.name: Speak and notify
voice.description: The mower speaks, and a notification goes out.

photo.name: Take a photo
photo.description: A photo of the person is taken and goes to the app's album.

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: At most one alert in this many minutes, on mowers that space their alerts.

set_robot_voice.name: Set robot voice
set_robot_voice.description: Change the volume of the mower's voice and the kinds of prompt it speaks. Whatever is left out stays as it is.

reset_consumable.name: Reset consumable
reset_consumable.description: Start a consumable's count over, as after replacing the blades or the station's cleaning brush, or after servicing the mower.

item.name: Consumable
item.description: The blades, the station's cleaning brush, or the mower's maintenance.

go_to_maintenance_point.name: Go to maintenance point
go_to_maintenance_point.description: Send the mower to a maintenance point of the current map, where it waits for cleaning or servicing. The mower drives there.

point_id.name: Maintenance point
point_id.description: The id of a maintenance point of the active map.

ignore_obstacle.name: Ignore obstacle
ignore_obstacle.description: Have the mower forget an obstacle its camera recognised, so it no longer shows on the map. This cannot be undone. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows.

obstacle_id.name: Obstacle
obstacle_id.description: The mower's id of the obstacle; the map card fills it in when an obstacle is ignored there.

backup_map.name: Back up map
backup_map.description: Back the current map up, replacing the backup it had. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

restore_map.name: Restore map
restore_map.description: Put the current map back as its backup has it, or with a slot bring a deleted map back from the backup kept in its empty slot. The map's schedules and mowing settings may be reset. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The empty map slot, numbered from 1, whose backup brings a deleted map back. Leave it out to restore the current map.

delete_map.name: Delete map
delete_map.description: Delete a map with everything on it. The map's backup is kept in its empty slot, from where restore_map brings it back; without a backup a new map has to be mapped in the app, driving the mower. The mower does not move for it, but refuses it while it mows or returns to its station.
